objective: Cruzar contrato estructural RBAC con evidencia SQL de solo lectura para determinar origen, vigencia y distribucion de Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion. Identificar si hay evidencia de migracion incompleta, decision administrativa o regla de negocio, sin asumir causalidad. Si la conexion apunta a Produccion o no se puede identificar entorno, detener consultas de datos y reportar bloqueo. No modificar SQL, permisos, sesiones, codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name, SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name

queries.name: assignment_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: assignment_status_counts
queries.sql: SELECT Activo, COUNT_BIG(*) AS assignments FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion GROUP BY Activo ORDER BY Activo

queries.name: assignment_user_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT UsuarioID, COUNT_BIG(*) AS assignments, SUM(CASE WHEN Activo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_assignments FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion GROUP BY UsuarioID ORDER BY UsuarioID

queries.name: assignment_company_distribution
queries.sql: SELECT EmpresaID, COUNT_BIG(*) AS assignments, SUM(CASE WHEN Activo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_assignments FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion GROUP BY EmpresaID ORDER BY EmpresaID
